request.spec:
An OPEN claim can no longer be edited; only a DRAFT can, and the edit of an open claim is refused
with an error on the claim. To change an open claim, void it and add a new one. A voided claim now
keeps its number (it is still never reused), and CLAIM_VOIDED carries it.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
An OPEN claim can no longer be edited; only a DRAFT can, and the edit of an open claim is refused
with an error on the claim. To change an open claim, void it and add a new one. A voided claim now
keeps its number (it is still never reused), and CLAIM_VOIDED carries it.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The change is in: only a DRAFT claim can be edited now, and a voided claim keeps its number. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**What changed**
- **Edits are refused unless the claim is a draft.** A new step, `CheckClaimDraft`, sits in the claim edit endpoint (`{claimId}.PUT.yml`). If the claim is OPEN or past that, the request fails with "A OPEN claim cannot be edited", and nothing is stored or written to the audit file.
- **Edits also can't race a status change.** The edit is saved with a new `ClaimStore.edit`, which only updates the row if it is still DRAFT and refuses the edit if not. Before, the edit wrote the claim's old status back, so an edit landing at the same moment as another user's "open" could undo the open.
- **Voiding keeps the number.** `ApplyStatus` no longer clears the number on void. The number counter is untouched, so numbers are still never reused. `CLAIM_VOIDED` already adds `number=<n>` when the claim has one, so a voided open claim now carries it. A draft that is voided has no number and logs none, as the spec expects.
- **Database:** I added `V15__claim_void_keeps_number.sql`. It only adds a comment to the `number` column describing the new rule, with no schema change. Claims voided before this change still have no number.
- Code comments (`Claim`, `StatusChange`, `ApplyStatus`, the PUT YAML) are updated to match.

**On screen:** the Edit button still shows on open claims, because the test presses it. When the save is refused, the error appears in the person's claim form (`claim-form-error`), not on the claim's own row as the request words it. That's what the test accepts. I didn't also show it on the row, because the test looks for either error and two visible at once could break it.
